title: Progression path: E to Nation
summary: The road from rank E to S, S+ and Nation: levels, dungeons to clear, rewards and what changes at each step.

blocks.text: Your rank is measured at the Awakened Registry. It depends on your level and on how many dungeons you cleared since your last rank. A rank is never lost.

blocks.text: Reach the level of the next rank. Clear the required number of dungeons (any rift counts, ideally of your rank). Talk to the Registry and ask for a re-evaluation. It is free and instant. Collect the rank-up reward (shards, boosts, a better class weapon...).
blocks.html:
1. Reach the level of the next rank.
  2. Clear the required number of dungeons (any rift counts, ideally of your rank).
  3. Talk to the Registry and ask for a re-evaluation. It is free and instant.
  4. Collect the rank-up reward (shards, boosts, a better class weapon...).

blocks.text: Rifts : you can enter rifts of a higher rank, with better rewards (see rifts ). Gear : the market stocks better gear in rifts of rank A and above, and loot grades depend on your rank. Titles and badges : each rank has its own title and badge. Bonus points : ranks S+ and Nation give extra stat and skill points.
blocks.html:
• Rifts: you can enter rifts of a higher rank, with better rewards (see rifts).
  • Gear: the market stocks better gear in rifts of rank A and above, and loot grades depend on your rank.
  • Titles and badges: each rank has its own title and badge.
  • Bonus points: ranks S+ and Nation give extra stat and skill points.

blocks.text: The level cap is 100 for the Human and the normal classes, 999 for the special classes. XP needed grows with every level: see Leveling . Past level 100, the special classes still earn a stat point every 5 levels up to 150, every 10 up to 500 and every 25 up to 999. Milestone rewards give big gifts every 50 levels from level 250.
